run_TestCase_test_interoperability: run a gRPC interoperability test case by calling TestCase member test_interoperability with a stub and args
test_Pipe_thread_safe_queue: test the Pipe class as a thread-safe producer-consumer queue for streaming gRPC calls
test_large_unary_common_behavior: test large unary gRPC call behavior with optional username, OAuth scope, and call credentials
test_custom_metadata: test sending and echoing initial and trailing metadata in gRPC unary and full-duplex calls
test_status_code_and_message: test that gRPC responses return the expected status code and status message details
